Intake Note (family request)

Mr. Mercer, a 23-year-old college student, was brought in today by his parents, who called the clinic asking for an evaluation. They describe gradual changes over the past ten months: he has pulled away from friends, his grades fell until he went on academic leave, he no longer keeps up with personal hygiene, and he has become suspicious of other people. He has no previous psychiatric history, no chronic medical illnesses, and takes no medications. He agreed to come today but says he does not understand why his parents are concerned. Evaluation requested.

Behavioral Observations (on arrival)

Appearance: Disheveled. Poor eye contact.

Behavior: Brought to the clinic by his parents. At times glances toward the corner of the room, as if listening.

Speech: Soft, with occasional thought blocking.

Mood / Affect: Mood "fine." Affect flat.

Thought / Perception: Thought processes mildly disorganized. Thought content notable for persecutory ideas and auditory hallucinations.

Cognition / Insight: Insight poor; judgment impaired.
